requiredCases.name: TASK-014 accidental Finish recovery with an aligned quiet undo > AC-R014-03 undo while running returns the same attempt within its original cap: the time spent finished counts and none is granted, the checked progress and the log’s entries come back, the answer returns to before Finish, and nothing completes the workout (AC-C38-01)

TASK-014 accidental Finish recovery with an aligned quiet undo > AC-C38-01 undo while paused pauses the same attempt again at the same moment with its progress; resumed, finished again and saved, each of two differently shaped attempts writes exactly one row with the truthful highest round completed

TASK-014 accidental Finish recovery with an aligned quiet undo > AC-R014-03 undo is withdrawn the moment it would resume at the original cap, unprompted and for good, and the cap itself is never undone: the finished time, the log and its correction stay and are saved

TASK-014 accidental Finish recovery with an aligned quiet undo > AC-R014-03 undo survives close and reopen and a failed save with its draft kept, and a successful save ends it at once and durably, even when a reopen cannot read the saved row back

TASK-014 accidental Finish recovery with an aligned quiet undo > AC-R014-01 the quiet undo sits below Complete and Incomplete and before Rounds completed, left-aligned with no inherited inset, the existing small quiet button at the shared control height, reached by Tab and taking no confirmation (AC-C39-01, AC-C60-01, AC-R014-02)

TASK-014 accidental Finish recovery with an aligned quiet undo > JOURNEY-014 the accepted gallery’s four- and twelve-round states draw the route’s own quiet undo: Finish, then Undo finish brings the same attempt back with its checked rounds, and its original cap withdraws it, over memory only

TASK-014 accidental Finish recovery with an aligned quiet undo > AC-R014-03 no stale completion survives an undo: an older build’s For Time answer stored beside an adopted clock never becomes the attempt’s answer, and For Time’s own Finish offers no undo
